description: Enumerate WebAssembly instructions with optional filters: `category` (control, numeric, parametric, variable, table, memory, ref, i31, struct, array, extern, vec), `introduced_in` (1.0 | 2.0 | 3.0), `prefix` (mnemonic prefix like `i32.`), and `can_trap` (only trapping / only non-trapping instructions). Returns lightweight rows (incl. `can_trap`) sorted by opcode; follow up with instruction_get for full detail incl. trap conditions.

can_trap.description: Filter by trapping behavior: `true` keeps only instructions that can trap at runtime, `false` keeps only those that never trap. See instruction_get for the per-instruction trap conditions.

category.description: Filter by instruction category: control, numeric, parametric, variable, table, memory, ref, i31, struct, array, extern, vec (vector/SIMD).

introduced_in.description: Filter to instructions introduced in this WebAssembly version: `1.0`, `2.0`, or `3.0`.

prefix.description: Filter to mnemonics starting with this prefix, e.g. `i32.` or `v128.`. Case-insensitive.

version.description: WebAssembly spec version to query. `latest` (default) is the current served version; `main` is the upstream working draft.

name: instruction_list
title: List instructions
